Permission: Access AI engine URL
Conditions / Notes: Baseline permission for every active registered user.

Permission: Create a Private Workspace and become its Owner
Conditions / Notes: Private Workspace remains owner-only until promoted or shared.

Permission: Access all settings sections
Conditions / Notes: Team-scoped and workspace-scoped settings are granted separately.

Permission: Add, disable, delete, promote, or demote platform users
Conditions / Notes: Cannot remove or demote the final active Platform Admin.

Permission: Create or delete Teams and appoint Team Leads
Conditions / Notes: Team Lead manages only an assigned Team and only when delegated.

Permission: View workspace and artifact ownership counts for a user
Conditions / Notes: Metadata view does not grant content access.

Permission: Initiate audited temporary access to protected content
Conditions / Notes: Requires reason, time limit, explicit activation, and audit. Does not allow silent impersonation.

Permission: Delete a user who owns Team Workspaces
Conditions / Notes: Transfer or archive accountable ownership first. Do not cascade-delete Team Workspaces.

Permission: Access own Team membership and skill-governance settings
Conditions / Notes: Team Lead scope is limited to their assigned Team.

Permission: Add or remove members in own Team
Conditions / Notes: Team Lead requires delegated membership authority and cannot remove the final Team Lead.

Permission: Assign or remove a Team Lead
Conditions / Notes: Direct privileged assignment by Platform Admin.

Permission: Create and edit a private improvement proposal for a Team-owned skill
Conditions / Notes: Requires membership in the skill-owning Team. Workspace roles do not grant this permission.

Permission: Submit a frozen skill proposal to the owning Team Lead
Conditions / Notes: Submission does not expose the proposer's ongoing private draft.

Permission: Review, comment on, approve, reject, or request changes on an ordinary Team skill proposal
Conditions / Notes: Platform Admin acts only through a Team Lead or Enterprise Skill Admin binding. Self-approval is blocked.

Permission: Approve a high-risk or exceptional skill version
Conditions / Notes: Platform Admin performs Enterprise Skill Admin duties in the MVP.

Permission: Assign an approved active skill version to own Team
Conditions / Notes: Must comply with enterprise policy and exact approved versions.

Permission: Assign a Team-owned skill to another Team
Conditions / Notes: Requires enterprise cross-Team assignment policy. Workspace sharing alone never grants the skill.

Permission: Suspend, restore, retire, or roll back own Team skill
Conditions / Notes: Team Lead authority is limited to Team-owned skills; Enterprise Skill Admin may act globally.

Permission: CRUD enterprise skill, MCP, tool, and KB catalog configuration
Conditions / Notes: Team Lead may manage Team assignments but cannot bypass the global catalog.

Permission: Edit an approved or active skill version in place
Conditions / Notes: Create and approve a new immutable version instead.

Permission: Use an assigned skill, MCP server, tool, or global KB
Conditions / Notes: Requires Team assignment plus workspace, skill declaration, connection, sandbox, and platform checks where applicable.

Permission: Create, refresh, or revoke own delegated OAuth/MCP connection
Conditions / Notes: A personal connection proves identity and is never shared with the Team.

Permission: Promote or share an owned Private Workspace as a Team Workspace
Conditions / Notes: The Private Workspace Owner performs the promotion; Team Lead approval is not required.

Permission: View and download authorized workspace artifacts
Conditions / Notes: Platform Admin and Team Lead need an explicit workspace role or audited break-glass access.

Permission: Chat or prompt against authorized workspace content
Conditions / Notes: Also requires independently authorized skills, knowledge, tools, MCP, and runtime policy.

Permission: Create notes visible only to the current user
Conditions / Notes: Private notes do not modify workspace content.

Permission: Create shared annotations, discussions, mentions, and tasks
Conditions / Notes: Mentions may target only principals that already have workspace access.

Permission: Upload files or revise current Team Workspace content
Conditions / Notes: Contributor changes enter the proposal queue in Review mode or autosave in Freeflow.

Permission: Submit revisions to the Team Workspace proposal queue
Conditions / Notes: Applies when Review mode is enabled.

Permission: Review, merge, reject, or request changes on workspace revision proposals
Conditions / Notes: Does not grant workspace access administration.

Permission: Edit the current Team Workspace directly with autosave
Conditions / Notes: Contributor permission is active only when Freeflow is enabled. Every revision is attributed.

Permission: View changes since the previous published version
Conditions / Notes: Contributors see their revisions and any history allowed by workspace policy.

Permission: Publish the current Team Workspace as an immutable version
Conditions / Notes: Publication freezes content, validation results, revision boundary, and exact skill manifest.

Permission: Release approved files to the GCS release bucket
Conditions / Notes: Keep this separate from workspace publication if GCS release has its own review lifecycle.

Permission: Set or change Review mode versus Freeflow
Conditions / Notes: Policy transition is audited and cannot discard pending proposals or revision history.

Permission: Grant or remove Viewer, Contributor, or Publisher access
Conditions / Notes: Publisher and Owner must be named-user assignments; Team grants may provide Viewer or Contributor.

Permission: Transfer accountable workspace ownership
Conditions / Notes: The system must always retain one active accountable Owner. Platform Admin action is break-glass only.

Permission: Archive or restore a Team Workspace
Conditions / Notes: Platform Admin action is audited emergency administration, not automatic workspace authority.

Permission: Restore a prior published version as a new current revision
Conditions / Notes: Historical versions are never mutated. Publisher restoration requires explicit workspace delegation.

Permission: Select or upgrade the exact approved skill version pinned to the workspace
Conditions / Notes: A workspace can pin only approved active versions; a private proposal cannot be inherited.

Permission: Invoke a skill pinned to the workspace
Conditions / Notes: Requires the exact pinned version through one of the user's Teams plus all runtime checks.

Permission: Create or update knowledge for the current workspace
Conditions / Notes: Contributor behaviour follows Review mode or Freeflow. Platform knowledge follows a separate curator flow.

Permission: Edit or bypass the read-only restriction of a published version
Conditions / Notes: Nobody edits immutable published content in place. Break-glass may grant read access only.

Permission: Grant workspace access to another Team or a registered user from another Team
Conditions / Notes: Workspace access does not merge skill catalogs or grant the pinned skill.

Permission: View why the current user has or lacks access
Conditions / Notes: Users see a concise reason and remediation action.

Permission: View the detailed effective authorization trace
Conditions / Notes: Team Lead scope is own Team; Workspace Owner scope is own workspace; Platform Admin sees governance metadata.

Permission: View immutable governance and publication audit events
Conditions / Notes: Scope audit visibility to the actor's governed Team or workspace.
